__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: Solaris PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: PostgreSQL datasource pointing at the Solaris production database

description: Per-agency CAD webhook delivery health — success rate, p95 latency proxy, last event timestamp, and DLQ depth.

panels.description: Percentage of webhook calls that successfully created or updated an alert vs total attempts (including DLQ entries) per agency, rolling 1 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.created_by AS agency_code,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source = 'CAD')
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.source = 'CAD') + COALESCE(dlq.fail_count, 0), 0),
  2) AS success_rate_pct
FROM solaris_alerts a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT agency_code, COUNT(*) AS fail_count
  FROM cad_webhook_dlq
  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  GROUP BY agency_code
) dlq ON dlq.agency_code = a.created_by
WHERE a.source = 'CAD'
  AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY a.created_by, dlq.fail_count
ORDER BY agency_code

panels.title: Delivery Success Rate (rolling 1 h) — per agency

panels.description: Timestamp of the most recent successfully ingested CAD event per agency.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  created_by AS agency_code,
  MAX(created_at) AS last_event_at
FROM solaris_alerts
WHERE source = 'CAD'
GROUP BY created_by
ORDER BY agency_code

panels.title: Last Event Timestamp — per agency

panels.description: CAD events ingested per minute per agency — use this time series for p95 latency approximation (inter-arrival time) and to spot drops.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time,
  created_by AS agency_code,
  COUNT(*) AS events_per_min
FROM solaris_alerts
WHERE source = 'CAD'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Events per Minute — per agency

panels.description: DLQ entries by status. A growing 'exhausted' count indicates systematic failures requiring investigation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT agency_code, status, COUNT(*) AS depth
FROM cad_webhook_dlq
WHERE status IN ('pending', 'exhausted')
GROUP BY agency_code, status
ORDER BY agency_code, status

panels.title: DLQ Depth — pending + exhausted entries per agency

title: CAD Webhook Health — Per-Agency
